cluster.headline: פחות מאחוז מהתושבים הצטרפו: הישראלים שנותרו מחוץ להנחות בחשמל

primary_source.name: Israel Electricity Authority (רשות החשמל), with IEC and Noga data, as relayed in its Sept 2026 announcement (ynet / mako, 09.09.26); per-locality breakdown not located

article_page_note: The article page's own headline differs from the homepage headline: '"הספקים מפסידים שוק משמעותי": גם בהנחות בחשמל החברה הערבית בחוץ'. The page subtitle reads: 'בעוד הממוצע הארצי של משקי הבית שעברו לחברות פרטיות עומד על כ–16%, בישובים ערביים רבים הצטרפו פחות מאחוז מהתושבים'. Only the teaser paragraph is visible; the rest is paywalled. gov.il Electricity Authority pages returned HTTP 403.

claims.claim_text: פחות מאחוז מהתושבים הצטרפו: הישראלים שנותרו מחוץ להנחות בחשמל
claims.verified_figure: National switching is about 16% of households (TheMarker's own subtitle). City-level shares reported from Electricity Authority data range from about 10% (Haifa, Bat Yam) to 33% (Modi'in Illit). The '<1%' figure applies, per the article itself, only to 'many Arab localities'.
claims.note: The homepage headline drops the scope qualifier. The article page's own headline and subtitle tie the '<1%' figure explicitly to Arab localities. Read on its own, the homepage headline lets a sector- and locality-specific figure pass as a general one about 'the Israelis', while national uptake is about 16%.

claims.claim_text: בישובים ערביים רבים הצטרפו פחות מאחוז מהתושבים
claims.note: Searches in Hebrew, Arabic and English found no published per-locality or Arab-sector switching data from the Electricity Authority, and none of the corroborating coverage (ynet, mako, Bizportal) mentions Arab localities. The figure is plausible but unverified. 'Many localities' is also undefined: we don't know how many, or how 'residents' versus households/meters were counted.

claims.claim_text: כ–430 אלף משקי בית עברו עד ספטמבר לספקי חשמל פרטיים
claims.verified_figure: Electricity Authority announcement (reported 09.09.26 by ynet/mako): about 450,000 households switched from July 2024 'until now'. Bizportal (14.09.26) reported more than 20,000 new switchers in August alone.
claims.note: 430k 'by September' fits the Authority's ~450k figure of early-to-mid September, given an end-of-August cutoff and monthly growth of 20k+. The check rests on the Authority's figure as relayed by other outlets, since the Authority site itself was blocked (403).

claims.claim_text: נתון זה משקף נתח של כ–16% ממשקי הבית
claims.note: None of the reachable coverage of the Authority data gives a national share, and none states a denominator. 16% is arithmetically plausible against roughly 2.7-2.8 million Israeli households, and it is consistent with city shares of 10-33%. We could not confirm the official figure or which denominator was used.

claims.claim_text: שמעניקים הנחה ממוצעת של 5%–6% על חשבון החשמל
claims.verified_figure: The Authority-based reports give a range of 5%-21% depending on the plan, with the deeper discounts only at set hours and only for smart-meter customers. Fixed plans run about 5%-7% (Bizportal, Globes). No published average was found.
claims.note: No average discount figure from the Authority or the Ministry of Energy was found. 5-6% sits within the fixed-plan range of 5-7% and is plausible as an effective average, but its method (weighted by customers or by consumption) is unknown.

audit_status: complete (body_ok=0: worked from visible teaser/subtitle plus secondary reports of Electricity Authority data)
